implementation.name: IKAOPM
implementation.notes: License: BSD-2-Clause, read from https://github.com/ika-musume/IKAOPM/blob/main/LICENSE ("BSD 2-Clause License, Copyright (c) 2022, Raki"). accuracy_id from the README feature list: "A cycle-accurate, die shot based, BSD2 licensed core ... Accurately emulates most signals of the actual chip ... All LSI test bits are implemented." The README also states it was reverse-engineered from Yamaha datasheets and the siliconpr0n YM2151 die shot and "does not reference any existing hard/soft core". verified_against_hardware is left unset: the README says the core is FPGA proven but cites no hardware comparison test.
